title: Families over the ring — 42 machine-checked theorems of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit and how they are bound
description:
Families over the ring — 42 machine-checked theorems of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit, one Lean namespace, wing the ring. 42 close by exhaustion over a finite domain (by decide); 1 rfl declaration(s) are listed and not sealed, by design. Every one is sealed live in the append-only ledger.

How these theorems are bound. "Entangled" is used in this deposit's honest sense: correlation by derivation, not quantum entanglement, and no information travels through it.

1 · Shared definitions. 13 definition(s) are used by two or more theorems, binding 45 pair(s); the theorems fall into 24 strand(s), the largest of 8. Most binding: gcd' (6), choose (5), primesUpTo30 (4), unitsMod (3), fib (3), fact (2). 9 theorem(s) name no definition of the file and stand on their own statement.

2 · Imports. Built on: no other cluster. Built on it: demand.lean, demand2.lean, elementary.lean. Checking this cluster needs 1 file(s): src/proof/families.lean.

3 · The joint address. The 42 sealed receipts fold to 07169aa9-011e-8535-b8f4-b3256bae3a46. Order-invariant: yes — the same root in reverse order. Altering one receipt changes it: yes, computed on this run. A content-address proves integrity, not truth.

4 · The address lattice. Each theorem sits at the seven ray values its page plots from its receipt, taken mod 9: a point of (ℤ/9)⁷. This cluster's centre is (8, 2, 0, 4, 3, 0, 6). Its nearest clusters, ranked by lift — pairs observed among each theorem's seven nearest points, over the pairs expected by chance from the two clusters' sizes: address.lean (19 observed, 7.92 expected, lift 2.4), demand3.lean (6 observed, 3.26 expected, lift 1.84), phenomena.lean (3 observed, 1.86 expected, lift 1.61). A lift near 1 is what chance gives. Mean distance between two of its theorems: 15.55; from one of its theorems to a theorem of another cluster: 15.52. A receipt is a hash, so nearness on this lattice is a property of the addresses, not of the mathematics; the mathematical binding is (1) and (2). Chance, measured: over 200 reshufflings of which cluster each point belongs to (seeded, so every rebuild gives the same numbers), a best lift at least this high arose in 27.5% of them — consistent with chance.

Prior art. quantifies the ℤ/9 arithmetic above; the underlying results are Fermat’s, Euler’s and Gauss’s Per-theorem prior-art searches — OEIS, zbMATH Open, OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv — are recorded, with what was searched, where and when, in the living ledger src/proof/novelty.json. No novelty is claimed here.
